q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Revenue Guidance

## (a) Time left until resolution
Q2 FY2027 earnings will likely be released in late August 2026 (fiscal quarters typically end in late July/early August). Today is August 13, 2026, so we are extremely close to or potentially at the earnings announcement date. This question may already have a known answer or be resolving within days.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The CURRENT RESEARCH provides the explicit answer: **NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue was released on May 20, 2026 and is $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%.**

This is stated clearly in the search results from official sources (investor.nvidia.com, SEC filings). The guidance range is therefore:
- Lower bound: $91.0B × 0.98 = **$89.18B**
- Upper bound: $91.0B × 1.02 = **$92.82B**
- Midpoint: **$91.0B**

Since this guidance has already been released (May 20, 2026), and today is August 13, 2026, the Q2 FY2027 earnings release has either already occurred or is imminent. The forward guidance figure of $91.0B ± 2% is the company's official statement.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- NVIDIA could issue a downward revision between now and the actual Q2 earnings release (though unlikely given the strong momentum from Q1's $81.6B in actual results)
- Unexpected macroeconomic deterioration
- Supply chain disruptions
- Competitive pressure materializing faster than anticipated

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- NVIDIA could issue an upward revision to guidance (possible given Q1 beat the estimate by ~$3.4B)
- Stronger-than-expected demand for AI chips continuing
- Potential mitigation of China revenue restrictions or policy changes
- Acceleration in enterprise adoption

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

Direct precedent from the provided research:
- **Q1 FY2027 actual revenue: $81.6B** (reported)
- **Q1 FY2027 guidance issued: $80B ± 2%** (implied from analyst estimates of $78.2B and the beat pattern)
- **Q2 FY2027 guidance issued: $91.0B ± 2%** (explicitly stated in current research)

The guidance of $91.0B represents an 11.5% sequential growth from Q1's $81.6B actual, which is consistent with NVIDIA's strong demand trajectory.

---

## Probability Assessment

Given that the official guidance has already been publicly released on May 20, 2026 at $91.0B ± 2%, the most likely outcome is that Q2 FY2027 revenue guidance will be reported as **$91.0 billion** in the earnings release. The ± 2% range gives us a confidence band, but the central point estimate is firm.

The question asks "What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance" — this has already been announced. The actual earnings release will confirm/reiterate this $91.0B figure (unless there's a revision, which is unlikely given the strong Q1 beat).

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue was released on May 20, 2026. The company expects revenue to be $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/). This figure is well above the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion, according to LSEG [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/). NVIDIA's guidance explicitly does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China in its outlook [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/).

For Q1 FY2027, NVIDIA reported record revenue of $81.6 billion, an 85% increase year-over-year [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), exceeding analyst estimates of $78.2 billion [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/). Gross margins for Q2 FY2027 are expected to be 74.9% (GAAP) and 75.0% (non-GAAP), plus or minus 50 basis points [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/).
